pinPolicy.finalRule: Conformance must be repeated against the final clean pushed post-PAY-bridge pins; the observed pins never authorize authoring.

selection.auditFinding: BASE-TFR-HRM-001 may already be semantically covered by the completed BASE-TFR-HRM-010 approval bridge, so a conformance decision must precede all code work.
duplicateAvoidance: BASE-TFR-HRM-008 is integrated and must not be reopened.
BASE-TFR-HRM-010 is the completed overlap reference; do not clone, rename or reimplement it as HRM-001.

purpose.outcome: Consolidate source-shaped workflow screens into the shared versioned Approval policy and decision contract with owner-side state guards.

primary.ownerRule: HRIS stores only the approval request reference and immutable decision receipt; it must not create private approval tables or bypass the shared decision state.

boundaries.possibleDeltaAfterSeparateStartToken: Only paths proven missing by the conformance matrix may be allocated; no provisional wildcard is granted.

migrationDecision.rule: Do not create a migration. If a later audit proves a schema delta, Control must issue a new exact lease and Start Token.

conformanceMatrix.check: The owner persists the PLAT-003 request reference and immutable decision receipt without a private approval engine.
workflowVersion and subjectRef are immutable and bound to the callback and correlationId.
Delegated approver scope is validated and maker, checker and subject cannot violate no-self-approval rules.
Exact callback replay returns the recorded outcome while mismatched replay or stale state fails without side effects.
Wrong tenant, purpose, resource, population or field policy is denied before HR data disclosure.
Targeted HRM-010 tests and evidence cover the full HRM-001 contract rather than only a similarly named UI flow.

acceptanceSummary: Produce a contract-by-contract PASS, FAIL or NOT_APPLICABLE matrix with file and test evidence for every conformance item.
A complete PASS closes BASE-TFR-HRM-001 as CONFORMANCE_CLOSE_NO_CODE and advances HRIS-HRM to BASE-TFR-HRM-002.
Any FAIL must identify the smallest exact owner-side delta; it does not grant authority to fix the delta.
No full repository test is required for preflight; run only existing targeted tests needed to prove or refute a matrix row.
startTokenGates: Pin clean pushed post-PAY-bridge dwp-dev heads once.
Complete the six-row conformance matrix against BASE-TFR-HRM-010.
If all rows pass, issue a no-code closure receipt instead of a Start Token and select HRM-002.
If any row fails, seal only the proven delta, exact writable paths, targeted tests and any newly required lease in a separate Start Token.

dispatchInstruction.message: Compare BASE-TFR-HRM-001 PLAT-003 requirements with the completed BASE-TFR-HRM-010 approval bridge and return the six-row evidence matrix. Do not edit any file, create a migration, branch or worktree, run broad suites, commit, push, merge, or implement a perceived gap. A gap becomes writable only through a separately issued Wave5 Start Token.
requiredReport: six-row PASS/FAIL/NOT_APPLICABLE matrix with exact evidence
if delta exists, smallest exact path and targeted-test proposal only
